Name: Skull Cavern Drill
Author: S1mmyy
Description:
This mod gives the custom [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6120]Dwarven Drill[/url] item an actual use, which is to create shafts in the Skull Caverns.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/S1mmyy/StardewMods/tree/master/Skull%20Cavern%20Drill/Skull%20Cavern%20Drill]Source code[/url]﻿
[/list]
